# Sourcify

This file provides an overview of the Sourcify API documentation.

## Bulk access and fair use (read this first)

The Sourcify API serves single contracts. It is not for bulk downloads. Do not crawl it.

### Pick the right source

- Many contracts, or the full dataset: use the Parquet export. It is free and updated daily. Docs: https://docs.sourcify.dev/docs/repository/download-dataset/
- SQL queries without a download: use the public BigQuery dataset. It is updated continuously. You need a Google account. Docs: https://docs.sourcify.dev/docs/bigquery/
- Plain-language questions about the dataset: use the AI Dataset Playground. Docs: https://docs.sourcify.dev/docs/dataset-playground/
- One contract, or a few contracts: use the API (see below).

To download the full Parquet dataset and keep it in sync, run this command. On later runs, it downloads only new or changed files.

```bash
aws s3 sync s3://sourcify-production-parquet-export/v2/ ./sourcify-dataset --endpoint-url https://storage.googleapis.com --no-sign-request
```

For current file counts and sizes, see https://export.sourcify.dev/v2/stats.json.

### Rules for API clients

- Do not loop over `/v2/contract/{chainId}/{address}` to collect many contracts. Use the dataset.
- Request only the fields that you need, for example `fields=abi` or `fields=sources`.
- Do not use `fields=all` in loops. It returns every field, including all source files. It is the most expensive request.
- Store responses. Do not fetch the same contract again.
- Requests are rate limited per client. If you get a `429` or `5xx` response, stop and wait.
- Retry with exponential backoff. If the response has a `Retry-After` header, wait at least that long.
- Do not use `/v2/verify/etherscan` to import many contracts. Use it only for the contracts that you need.
- If the dataset does not fit your use case, email hello@sourcify.dev.

## Sourcify API versions:

- v1 (deprecated; don't use it)
- v2 (preferred; choose this)

## API specification (use this URL):

https://sourcify.dev/server/api-docs/swagger.json

### How to read the swagger file

The `swagger.json` file above is structured as follows:

```json
{
    "openapi": "OPENAPI_VERSION",
    "info": {
        "version": "SOURCIFY_VERSION",
    },
    "servers": [
        { "url": "https://sourcify.dev/server", "description": "Production server" },
        ...
    ],
    "paths": {
        "SOURCIFY_API_PATH": {
            "HTTP_METHOD": { /* OPENAPI SPECIFICATIONS */ }
        }
    }
}
```

### To verify smart contracts read

- paths["/v2/verify/{chainId}/{address}"].post

### Check verification job status

- paths["/v2/verify/{verificationId}"].get

### To read smart contracts read

- paths["/v2/contract/{chainId}/{address}"].get

## Repository UI

Contract's data can be viewed in the web application at https://repo.sourcify.dev/{chainId}/{address}.

- Do not use this repository to retrieve individual files.
- LLMs should not use this repository for data exploration; use the API referenced above instead.
- You may share links to this repository with users who want to browse contract's data through the UI.
